title: 第11章 以二对八团灭第12章 海量气血炼体六重巅峰
content_zh:
虽说叶无尘的率先出手打了他们一个出其不意。
但这群武者既然敢在天断山外围游荡，自身实力与反应自然不会太差。
就在短刀马上就要落在刀疤男身上的时候。
那领头的独眼男子终于反应了过来，一把推开了刀疤男，使其躲过了这致命一击。
叶无尘见状，手中短刀调转方向，径直朝独眼男子刺去。
两人靠的十分之近，独眼男子根本没有时间做出闪躲，只能选择挥刀挡下这一击。
随着一道金铁碰撞之声响起，独眼男子被震退数步，同时一口逆血涌上喉尖，被他强行咽了下去。
“好恐怖的力道。”
领头的独眼男子神色复杂的看向叶无尘，心中暗自惊惧。
“小子，你找死！”
刀疤男终于是反应了过来，只见他从腰间抽出大刀，径直朝叶无尘刺去。
而在同时，他身旁的两名同伴也是挥舞着长刀朝叶无尘冲来。
面对三人的围攻，叶无尘丝毫不见慌乱。
只见他身形一闪，躲过这两人攻击的同时，右手手腕猛然转动。
伴随着皮肤被割裂的触感，刀疤男看着叶无尘手中那滴血的短刀，一脸的不可置信。
在他的咽喉处，一道血痕浮现，鲜血止不住的喷洒出来。
从叶无尘出手到刀疤男死亡，时间仅仅才过去五息。
能被誉为秦国第一妖孽，当年的他还在破脉之时就能战胜炼体境的武者。
而这一切都归功于他那恐怖的战斗技巧。
反握短刀，叶无尘目光扫视众人，淡淡开口道：“第一个。”

“小子，你死定了！”
领头的独眼男子一脸愤怒的看向叶无尘。
而此刻，叶无尘的身形再次爆射而来。
这一次，众人心中也都收起了那一股不屑之意，皆是一脸凝重的看向叶无尘。
队伍最前方，那两名手持长刀的男子一左一右攻向叶无尘，封死了他的进攻路线。
就当他们以为叶无尘会选择暂避锋芒之时。
叶无尘却选择将手中的短刀猛的射向左手处那名男子，以此来阻碍对方的支援。
同时，他的身形则快速朝右手处的男子冲去，无可匹敌的一拳径直朝对方的面门轰杀而去。
千钧一发之际，独眼男子手中长刀袭来，试图逼退叶无尘。
可谁知叶无尘压根没有后退的打算。
只见他伸出左手，猛然一握，竟直接将长刀抓在手中，顷刻间，他的左手鲜血直流。
但他的右手之上，伏世拳已然轰杀而出，砸向了之前那名朝他出手的长刀男子。
一声闷响过后，长刀男子整个头颅都凹陷了下去，显然是死的不能再死了。
“疯子！”
独眼男子见到这一幕，神色惊骇。
以伤换命，这样的战斗方式不是疯子还是什么？
“第二个。”
叶无尘的声音再次响起。
“兄弟们，这小子就一个人，一起上，给我将他大卸八块！”
独眼男子强忍住内心的惊惧，低吼一声。

霎时间，在他身旁，一群人顿时朝着叶无尘冲了过来。
看到这群人的垂死挣扎，叶无尘淡漠的开口道：“谁告诉你，我只有一个人了？”
话音落下，他的身旁，叶夕月手中一把长枪浮现，轻而易举的就将一名男子的心口洞穿。
content_en:
Although Ye Wuchen took the lead and caught them by surprise.
But since this group of warriors dare to wander outside Tianduan Mountain, their own strength and reaction will naturally not be too bad.
Just when the short knife was about to fall on the scarred man.
The leading one-eyed man finally reacted and pushed the scarred man away, allowing him to avoid the fatal blow.
Seeing this, Ye Wuchen turned the short knife in his hand and stabbed straight towards the one-eyed man.
The two of them were so close that the one-eyed man had no time to dodge and could only choose to block the blow with his knife.
As the sound of gold and iron colliding sounded, the one-eyed man was knocked back several steps. At the same time, a mouthful of blood rushed to the tip of his throat, and he swallowed it forcefully.
"What a terrifying strength."
The leading one-eyed man looked at Ye Wuchen with a complicated expression, secretly frightened in his heart.
"Boy, you are looking for death!"
The scarred man finally reacted. He pulled out the big knife from his waist and stabbed Ye Wuchen directly.
At the same time, the two companions beside him also charged towards Ye Wuchen with long knives.
Faced with the siege of three people, Ye Wuchen showed no signs of panic.
He was seen dodging the attacks of the two men, and at the same time, he suddenly turned his right wrist.
With the feeling of the skin being cut, the scarred man looked at the bloody dagger in Ye Wuchen's hand with a look of disbelief.
A trace of blood appeared at his throat, and blood spurted out uncontrollably.
From the time Ye Wuchen took action to the death of the scarred man, only five breaths passed.
To be known as the number one monster in the Qin Kingdom, he was able to defeat the warriors of the Body Refining Realm when he was still breaking his pulse.
And all this is due to his terrifying fighting skills.
Holding the short knife behind his back, Ye Wuchen glanced at everyone and said calmly: "The first one."
"Boy, you're dead!"
The leading one-eyed man looked at Ye Wuchen with an angry look.
At this moment, Ye Wuchen's figure burst out again.
This time, everyone put away their disdain and looked at Ye Wuchen with solemn faces.
At the front of the team, the two men holding long knives attacked Ye Wuchen from the left and the right, blocking his attack route.
Just when they thought Ye Wuchen would choose to avoid the edge temporarily.
However, Ye Wuchen chose to shoot the short knife in his hand at the man on his left hand to hinder the opponent's support.
At the same time, his body quickly rushed towards the man on his right, and an unrivaled punch went straight towards the opponent's face.
At the critical moment, the one-eyed man struck with a long knife in his hand, trying to force Ye Wuchen back.
But who knew that Ye Wuchen had no intention of retreating.
He stretched out his left hand, grasped it suddenly, and grabbed the long knife directly in his hand. In an instant, his left hand was bleeding.
But on his right hand, Fushi Fist had already blasted out, hitting the man with the long knife who had shot at him before.
After a muffled sound, the man with the long knife's entire head sunk in. It was obvious that he could no longer die.
"Crazy!"
The one-eyed man looked horrified when he saw this scene.
Trading injuries for lives, isn't this a crazy way of fighting or what?
"The second one."
Ye Wuchen's voice sounded again.
"Brothers, this kid is alone, come together and cut him into pieces for me!"
The one-eyed man suppressed the fear in his heart and roared.
In an instant, beside him, a group of people rushed towards Ye Wuchen.
Seeing the desperate struggle of this group of people, Ye Wuchen said indifferently: "Who told you that I am only one person?"
As he finished speaking, a spear appeared in Ye Xiyue's hand next to him, and it easily pierced a man's heart.
